subject: Post-call: deployment mode & security follow-up (HIPAA, SOC2, BAA)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha@elarahealth.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: deployment mode & security follow-up (HIPAA, SOC2, BAA)

Hi Samantha -

Thanks again for the time today - great conversation and super helpful context on Elara's security and deployment constraints. Quick recap and next steps from our side:

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary need: PHI processing for clinical workflows (notes + lab interfaces) - must be HIPAA-covered with a signed BAA.
- Deployment preference: start evaluation with Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) for predictable throughput; Private VPC/on-prem is a hard requirement only if audit requires complete network isolation.
- SOC2: Elara requires SOC2 Type II report and supporting evidence for the control domains relevant to storage/access/monitoring.
- Timeline: target pilot in Q4; security review + BAA negotiation in the next 2-3 weeks would keep us on schedule.

Attachments I shared: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (high-level control map), HIPAA_BAA_template.docx (standard template we use). Also attaching our Dedicated architecture diagram for reference.

Next steps / asks:
1) Can you confirm whether Elara needs private on-prem deployment for the pilot, or if Dedicated in a VPC with customer-managed keys would be acceptable? (This will determine contract and infra work.)
2) Please share the list of security evidence items your audit team will want (auditor name, specific control areas, any custom questionnaires).
3) Would you like a security deep-dive next week with our infra/security lead (Dylan) and our legal lead (Neha) to go through SOC2 artifacts and BAA redline?

I'll follow up with Dylan and Neha to make sure we have the right artifacts ready.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

--
Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (attached)
HIPAA_BAA_template.docx (attached)
Redwood_Dedicated_architecture.png (attached)

From: Samantha Reed <samantha@elarahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya@elarahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: deployment mode & security follow-up (HIPAA, SOC2, BAA)

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the clear recap - that aligns with our notes. A few clarifying questions from our side:

1) Data residency: all PHI must remain in AWS us-east-1 for now. Will Redwood Dedicated in us-east-1 satisfy this?
2) SOC2 artifacts: can you provide the full SOC2 Type II report (not just a summary) or at least an auditor letter and shadowed control evidence? Our auditors usually ask for auditor contact info (who performed the audit) and date range covered.
3) BAA: we'll have small redlines from Legal; is it OK to send those back to Neha directly?
4) On-prem connector: for future phases, we may need an on-prem agent or connector to sync certain logs. Does Redwood Private support a customer-managed connector, or is that a separate engineering project?

If you can confirm the answers, let's schedule the security deep-dive - Wednesday or Thursday next week would work for our security and compliance folks.

Thanks,
Samantha
Head of Security & Compliance, Elara Health
samantha@elarahealth.com
(555) 867-2142

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: deployment mode & security follow-up (HIPAA, SOC2, BAA)

Hi Samantha -

Quick answers to your questions (posting here so Marissa has a record):

1) Data residency: yes - Redwood Dedicated can be provisioned in AWS us-east-1 and we can restrict routing/storage to that region for the pilot. We also support customer-managed KMS for encryption-at-rest.

2) SOC2 artifacts: we can share the full SOC2 Type II report under NDA/secure link. Auditor: Veritas Assurance LLP (contact: audits@veritas-assurance.com). Coverage period: 2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30. The SOC2 packet we provide typically includes: SOC2 report, auditor letter, complementary user-entity control mapping, and sample evidence for access reviews and change management. We'll place the packet in a restricted Drive link and share it via our security portal (link below).

3) BAA: absolutely - please send redlines to neha_kapoor@redwood.ai. Neha will handle legal review and loop in our contracts team for expedited turnaround.

4) On-prem connector: Redwood Private supports an agent-based connector pattern for log/metrics sync, but full on-prem integration (air-gapped installs) is a formal engagement with our Professional Services team. For the pilot, we can expose secure webhooks or an S3 sync + transfer agent.

I've uploaded the SOC2 packet and architecture diagram here: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/Elara-Security-Pack (access restricted; I'll send a secure link to your security portal).

If you want, I can lock in a 60-minute security deep-dive on Thursday 8/12 at 10am ET - Marissa, Neha and I will join. Samantha, does that time work for Elara?

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Infra & Security Lead, Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
